title: Resolution tracking - Kalshi DEMO environment
purpose: Track the watchlist events until they resolve, and record how each resolved (result = yes or no), with the official settlement timestamp. Updated by the live tracker page (pages/demo-live.html) in the browser when the demo API is reachable; the entries below are the verified snapshot taken on 2026-11-20.
how_resolution_is_read: A binary market's 'result' field is 'yes' or 'no' once finalized (status 'finalized'), with settlement_value_dollars 1.0000 for yes and 0.0000 for no, plus settlement_ts. For mutually-exclusive events (e.g. tournament winner), exactly one market resolves yes.
